kind_why: Scene headings such as “SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER” combine performed action (“He quickly picks it up and runs after her.”) with character-labelled dialogue.
language_of_dialogue: Sinhala, with occasional English words and phrases.

problems.what: The Sinhala vowel sign precedes its consonant in extracted character order; this should be “වෙන්න”.
Letters and vowel components are missing or displaced: intended “ඔයාගේ ෆෝන්”.
Missing consonant and damaged vowel sequence; intended “හැමදේම”.
Sinhala vowel signs appear before the consonants they belong to; intended “කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්”.
Missing letters: “මෙ” has lost “ග” from “මගේ”, and “වාපාරය” has lost the conjunct in “ව්‍යාපාරය”.
